fusions.name: Reaping Arrow
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 22 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Sweeping Stand
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Gathered Edge
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Bringing In the Crop
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your damage rises 20% for 6 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
